name: 0dtetrader
description: 0dteTrader — rapid options trading app for Webull OpenAPI

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run dev --workspace apps/api
scripts.dev:all: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.build:electron: npm run build && npm run electron:dist --workspace apps/desktop
